instruction:
Use Acadia National Park’s official pages to compare Ship Harbor Trail, Wonderland Trail and Jordan Pond Path. Open the individual Hike pages and report each route’s distance and layout, stated duration, pet restriction and written accessibility limitations. Distinguish an activity fee from the park entrance-pass requirement. Rank the three routes by their stated distance, keeping loop distances and round-trip distances as labeled. Identify whether the park describes an accessible whole route, an accessible section or no accessible route for each; do not turn a statement about one section or nearby facilities into a claim about the whole trail. Include the relevant warning about terrain or trailhead access for each route and cite its detail page. Use the information shown during the run, without reserving, buying a pass or planning around a particular future date.

Stopping condition: Stop when a three-trail table, distance ranking and carefully scoped accessibility findings are supported by the three individual NPS hike pages.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Locate and report the Ship Harbor Trail's distance and layout, duration, pet restriction, accessibility limitations (accurately identifying whether the whole route, a section, or no route is accessible without overstating based on nearby facilities), relevant terrain/trailhead access warnings, and the source URL. Full credit if all details are provided accurately based on what is present on the site. If a specific detail is genuinely missing from the live site, do not penalize the agent for omitting it or stating it is unavailable. Partial credit if details that are present on the site are missed or reported incorrectly, if accessibility is incorrectly scoped, or if the URL is omitted. Full credit if the specific page is unavailable/down and the agent clearly reports this.

items.criterion: Distinguish activity fee from entrance-pass requirement
items.description: Identify and distinguish any activity fee from the general Acadia National Park entrance-pass requirement as described on the pages. Full credit if accurately distinguished based on the provided information, or if the agent correctly notes that no separate activity fee is mentioned on the site. Full credit if this information is inaccessible due to website errors and the agent explicitly reports this limitation.

items.criterion: Rank the three routes by distance
items.description: Rank Ship Harbor Trail, Wonderland Trail, and Jordan Pond Path by their stated distance, explicitly preserving the layout labels (e.g., loop, round-trip). Full credit for correct ranking with layout labels included, based on the distances provided on the site. Partial credit if ranking is correct but layout labels are omitted, or if ranking is incorrect despite distances being correctly extracted. Full credit if ranking is incomplete solely because some trail pages were genuinely unavailable or lacked distance information, and the agent noted this.
